subject: Partner syndication + revenue split proposal for vector storage partners
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@pinecone.io>, Leah Kim <leah@silverline.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner syndication + revenue split proposal for vector storage partners

Hi Ari / Leah —

Thanks again for the productive calls last week. Per our discussion, Im sending a draft of Redwoods proposed syndication framework for vector-storage partners. High-level goals: reduce customer procurement friction, create predictable economics for Redwood + partner, and enable a clean co-sell motion where both parties can offer a bundled technical support promise.

Attachment: redwood_syndication_term_sheet_v1.pdf (term sheet stub)
Attachment: poc_scope_v2.xlsx (sample scope / milestones)

Top-line items were proposing:
- 70/30 revenue split in favor of Redwood on hosted inference + storage when Redwood leads the commercial engagement (we can flip if partner brings the customer).
- Standardized SSO + joint onboarding checklist; Redwood owns inference SLA, partner owns storage availability claims and tiering.
- 30-day co-marketing credit for first three customers who close under the syndication program.
- S3-fallback acceptance: partner storage must support cold-tier exports to S3 when customers opt for lower-cost archival.

Questions for you: any non-negotiables on split or legal terms from Pinecone/Silverline side? Also want to confirm timeline for a short POC (2–4 weeks) we can use as a proof point.

If youre comfortable, wed like to present this at our partner sync next Tuesday (08/17).

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference | hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
From: Ari Kaplan <ari@pinecone.io>

Subject: Re: Partner syndication + revenue split proposal for vector storage partners

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear draft. Quick notes from Pinecone legal/commercial: 

- Split: Pinecone typically prefers a 60/40 in favor of the infrastructure provider for managed index + storage. We could accept 70/30 if Redwood commits to a minimum quarterly ramp (e.g., >= $30k ARR from syndication-sourced deals within 90 days) or if the partner-sourced flip is explicit in the contract.
- POC timeline: 3 weeks is doable on our side, well need a small sample dataset and an SSO test tenant.
- S3 fallback: we have no objections to export-to-S3; want to clarify who bears egress costs.

Im copying our commercial lead separately (cc dropped into CRM). Wed like to see the final term sheet with a clause for annual review of split.

Regards,
Ari
Ari Kaplan
Head of Partnerships, Pinecone

Pinecone | ari@pinecone.io
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner syndication + revenue split proposal for vector storage partners

HQ folks —

Looping in some quick commercial/ops concerns from the sales-eng perspective: 

- Egress cost responsibility: we should avoid Redwood carrying unbounded egress for partner-hosted customers. Proposed: egress is billed to the customer unless the partner explicitly absorbs it as part of a promotional credit. Put language into the term sheet that egress exceptions require documented approval.
- Minimum performance SLAs: require partner to commit to a 99.9% index availability and <50ms median lookup for hot tier (on partner-certified infra). That ensures the Redwood inference SLOs arent undermined.
- Deal registration: include a 45-day registration window for co-sell credit so our SDRs / AE compensation can be cleanly assigned in Salesforce.

Ill mark the term sheet with these redlines and attach an ops checklist.

Prio
Prio (Priyom) Das
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — Silverline reviewed and were excited. A few practical notes from the consultancy angle: 

- Implementation fee carve-out: for professional services wed like to retain up to 80% of PS fees when we own the implementation. Redwood can keep the remainder for joint onboarding support.
- Case study consent: well need explicit customer opt-in for joint logos/case studies — include an opt-in checkbox in the contracting flow.
- POC dataset: we can provide a representative knowledge base (anonymized) to speed the POC; want to validate the S3 export format early.

Leah
Leah Kim

Team —

Great feedback, all of it actionable. Next steps Im locking in: 
1) Ill update the term sheet to call out: egress default to customer, explicit egress exceptions require partner approval; 70/30 split conditional on $30k ARR ramp or documented partner-sourced deals; annual review clause.
2) Prio: please add the registration + SLA language to the ops checklist and send back by EOD Monday.
3) Laura / Sergio: want your sign-off on co-marketing credit mechanics (how we track and redeem).
4) Ari / Leah: can you confirm POC start dates by EOD Friday and share the contact for SSO/test tenant?

If were aligned, Ill schedule a 30-min partner sync for 08/17 to finalize and agree on a pilot customer. Thanks everyone — this is moving fast in the right direction.

Hannah
